signatures.description: Implement a multipath transport scheduler that estimates per-path delivery rate and RTT under asymmetric clock skew, packet reordering, and intermittent ACK compression, then migrates traffic without creating a congestion burst. Enforce per-path and aggregate in-flight limits while handling path failure and recovery, and make the estimator robust to stale samples and counter wraparound.
